title: Structural Review, Relocation and Cash Settlement Limits by HomeCare Program
content:
The claims-side limits of the Calloway Limited Home Warranty differ by HomeCare program: whether a disputed structural finding goes to an independent structural engineer at Calloway's cost, the nightly relocation reimbursement while the home is uninhabitable during a covered structural or systems repair, the most nights and the most dollars of relocation reimbursement per claim item, the cash-in-lieu maximum, and the business days within which an approved payout is paid.

| Program | Independent engineer review of a disputed structural finding | Relocation reimbursement per night | Maximum nights per claim item | Reimbursement cap per claim item | Cash-in-lieu maximum per claim item | Payout issued within (business days of approval) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Standard | Not included | USD 150.00 | 5 | USD 1000.00 | USD 500.00 | 10 |
| HomeCare 1-2-10 Select | Not included | USD 150.00 | 5 | USD 1000.00 | USD 500.00 | 10 |
| HomeCare 1-3-10 Plus | Included | USD 175.00 | 7 | USD 1500.00 | USD 750.00 | 10 |
| HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred | Included | USD 200.00 | 10 | USD 2500.00 | USD 1000.00 | 10 |
| HomeCare 2-5-10 Premier | Included | USD 225.00 | 14 | USD 3500.00 | USD 1500.00 | 10 |
| HomeCare 2-5-15 Reserve | Included | USD 275.00 | 21 | USD 6000.00 | USD 2500.00 | 10 |

The cash-in-lieu maximum is the largest cash settlement Calloway may offer instead of repairing a covered non-structural item, counted per claim item.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Under HomeCare 2-3-10 Preferred the nightly figure is USD 200.00, at most 10 nights may be reimbursed on one claim item, and the reimbursement on that item may not pass USD 2500.00; the largest cash settlement on one covered non-structural item is USD 1000.00.
